dialogues.speaker: Helene
dialogues.text: He—Hello... Do you have a request for me?

choices.text: Take care of your mental well-being and enjoy your work!

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I—Is that all？ There's no... 100-page set of requirements?

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Phew... It looks like I've finally caught a break. A nice, easy assignment...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Although, at most, it might keep me busy for a couple of months... If only I could work here forever...

choices.text: I get the impression I intimidate you...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Oh, no, I'm not intimidated, just cautious! You know what they say... "Never upset the client." Haha...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: Besides, given all the help you've lent me in the past, it's important that I show you the proper respect!

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I can't afford to get fired again. The way the market is right now, it's not a good time to be looking for work as a freelance engineer...

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I like this position. I'll work as hard as it takes to get the job done!

response.speaker: Helene
response.text: I—In that case, I won't disturb you. I should get back to my work...
